caption:
Chilli Oil Mushroom Nooodles
Paneer Macros:
C: 46 | F: 41 | P: 24
Calories: 645 per serving
Serves 2 

Chicken Macros:
C: 49 | F: 24 | P: 28
Calories: 481 per serving
Serves 2 depending on how hungry you are

Ingredients
1/2 tsp chilli oil (only oil)
1 tsp minced garlic + 1/2 tsp garlic ginger paste
1 onion, sliced
200 grams button mushroom 
1 capsicum, thinly sliced
1-2 tbsp chilli oil
80 grams noodles, i used udon 
150 grams paneer, you can replace with tofu or chicken ( if using chicken, add 100 grams per person for a great protein boost) macros as mentioned for both 

Method
start by making your noodles
in a pan add in a little chilli oil just the oil and add in the onion and garlic, saute till translucent. 
add in the mushroom and cook it down till all the water evaporates then add in the capsicum
add in the cooked noodles and chilli oil and toss
add the noodles to a bowl and in the same pan, add in the paneer and cook till its nice and brown :) 
top with fresh coriander and enjoy 
Brands used: @masterchow.in chilli oil and udon noodles along with the garlic chilli crisp
